terms.definitionEn: A concise document name used in browser interfaces and commonly shown as a search-result link.
terms.definitionAr: اسم مختصر للمستند بيظهر في المتصفح وغالبًا كرابط في نتيجة البحث.

terms.definitionEn: A metadata value that summarizes a page and may be used as a search-result snippet.
terms.definitionAr: قيمة وصفية بتلخص الصفحة وممكن تظهر كمقتطف في نتيجة البحث.
terms.example: <meta name="description" content="A guide to balcony herbs">

terms.definitionEn: A small site icon that browsers can show in tabs or other interface locations.
terms.definitionAr: أيقونة صغيرة للموقع ممكن تظهر في ألسنة المتصفح أو أماكن تانية في الواجهة.

terms.definitionEn: An attribute identifying the primary tongue used by document content.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد اللغة الأساسية لمحتوى المستند.

terms.definitionEn: A metadata directive that can express crawling or indexing preferences for compliant crawlers.
terms.definitionAr: توجيه وصفي ممكن يحدد تفضيلات الزحف أو الفهرسة للبرامج اللي بتحترمه.

terms.definitionEn: A metadata vocabulary used by social platforms to describe shared pages.
terms.definitionAr: مجموعة بيانات وصفية بتستخدمها منصات التواصل لوصف الصفحات المشتركة.

terms.definitionEn: A social-sharing metadata property that names the shared page.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية للبيانات الوصفية بتحدد اسم الصفحة عند مشاركتها اجتماعيًا.

terms.definitionEn: A social-sharing metadata property that identifies an image for a page preview.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية وصفية بتحدد صورة لمعاينة الصفحة عند مشاركتها.

terms.definitionEn: A link identifying the preferred URL when substantially similar pages have multiple addresses.
terms.definitionAr: رابط بيحدد العنوان المفضل لما يكون للمحتوى المتشابه أكتر من عنوان.

terms.definitionEn: A metadata value suggesting a color for browser interface surfaces associated with the page.
terms.definitionAr: قيمة وصفية بتقترح لونًا لبعض أجزاء واجهة المتصفح المرتبطة بالصفحة.

terms.definitionEn: A robots directive asking compliant search crawlers not to include a page in results.
terms.definitionAr: توجيه لبرامج البحث المتوافقة إنها ما تضيفش الصفحة للنتائج.

terms.definitionEn: A link relationship marking the preferred address for a document's content.
terms.definitionAr: علاقة في الرابط بتحدد العنوان المفضل لمحتوى المستند.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the title element?
options: It names the document in browser interfaces
It creates the page's main visible heading
It supplies the image used for social sharing
It tells crawlers to exclude the document
questions.explanation: title names the document and can be used in browser tabs and search-result links.
questions.explanationAr: عنصر title بيسمي المستند وممكن يظهر في لسان المتصفح ونتيجة البحث.

questions.code: <meta name="description" content="A short guide to harbor walks">
questions.question: What does this metadata value summarize?
options: The page's content for a possible search-result snippet
The image file used as the browser favicon
The language used by every page on the website
The canonical destination of every hyperlink
questions.explanation: A meta description summarizes a page and may be used as a search-result snippet; search engines choose what to display.
questions.explanationAr: وصف meta بيلخص الصفحة وممكن يُستخدم كمقتطف، ومحرك البحث هو اللي بيختار العرض.

questions.prompt: Give the document a concise name for its browser tab.
questions.explanation: The title element provides the document name rather than body text.

questions.question: What does lang="fr" communicate here?
options: The URL path to a French translation
The text direction for every element
The preferred color for browser controls
The document's primary language
questions.explanation: lang identifies the language used by the element's text and supports language-aware tools.
questions.explanationAr: lang بتحدد لغة النص وبتساعد الأدوات اللي بتتعامل مع اللغة.

questions.prompt: Declare the main document language as Spanish.
questions.explanation: The lang attribute declares the language of the document or a section.

questions.question: What resource is this link intended to identify?
options: A canonical version of the current article
A social-sharing description for search engines
An audio track for captions
A site icon for browser interfaces
questions.explanation: rel="icon" links an icon resource that browsers may use in their interface.
questions.explanationAr: rel="icon" بيربط أيقونة ممكن المتصفح يستخدمها في واجهته.

questions.explanation: The heading and paragraph are visible content in their document order.
questions.explanationAr: العنوان والفقرة محتوى ظاهر بترتيب المستند.

questions.prompt: Provide a short summary that may be used as a search-result snippet.
questions.code: <meta name="____" content="Walking routes along the harbor">
questions.explanation: The name value identifies this metadata as the page description.

questions.question: How may a social platform use this property?
options: As the file path for the page's stylesheet
As a command to prevent indexing
As the canonical URL of the document
As the shared-preview title
questions.explanation: og:title supplies a title value for social-sharing metadata previews.
questions.explanationAr: og:title بتوفر عنوانًا لمعاينة الصفحة عند مشاركتها.

questions.prompt: Declare a preview image URL using the Open Graph image property.
questions.explanation: og:image identifies an image that social-sharing tools may use in a preview.

questions.explanation: Open Graph metadata is not body text; the heading and paragraph are visible.
questions.explanationAr: بيانات Open Graph مش نص body ظاهر، لكن العنوان والفقرة ظاهرين.

questions.question: What does this canonical link identify?
options: Preferred URL among similar pages
The location of a site's icon
The text shown inside the main heading
A restriction that blocks every crawler
questions.explanation: A canonical link indicates the preferred URL for substantially similar content.
questions.explanationAr: رابط canonical بيحدد العنوان المفضل للمحتوى المتشابه.

questions.prompt: Declare the preferred URL for this article.
questions.explanation: rel="canonical" identifies the preferred address for the page's content.
The metadata image URL is not visible body text; the paragraph is displayed.
questions.explanationAr: عنوان صورة metadata مش نص ظاهر في body، لكن الفقرة بتظهر.

questions.prompt: Ask compliant search crawlers not to include this page in their index.
questions.explanation: noindex is a directive for compliant crawlers not to include a page in search results.

questions.question: What does the noindex directive request from a compliant search crawler?
options: Do not include this page in search results
Do not follow any link anywhere on the site
Delete the page from the web server
Block every visitor from loading the page
questions.explanation: noindex requests that a compliant crawler not include the page in its search index; it does not remove the page from the server.
questions.explanationAr: noindex بيطلب من crawler متوافق ما يضيفش الصفحة لفهرس البحث، لكنه مش بيمسحها من الخادم.

questions.prompt: Point this duplicate page to its preferred HTTPS address.
questions.explanation: The canonical href contains the preferred page URL.

questions.question: What do these two properties provide together?
options: A complete guarantee of ranking position in search results
The page's canonical address and crawler permissions
The visible heading and image caption in the body
A shared-page preview title and image
questions.explanation: og:title and og:image describe a title and image for social-sharing previews; they do not guarantee how a platform renders them.
questions.explanationAr: og:title وog:image بيوصفوا عنوان وصورة لمعاينة المشاركة، لكن المنصة بتقرر العرض.

questions.prompt: Set the robots metadata to request indexing be disallowed for this page.
questions.explanation: noindex requests exclusion from search results, while follow is a separate crawler directive.

questions.question: How do the document title and meta description contribute differently to search presentation?
keyPoints: title names the document and often supplies a result link
Search engines may rewrite either presentation
questions.modelAnswer: The title names the document and often informs the clickable title in a search result, while the description summarizes its content. Search engines may choose different text, so both should be accurate and specific without assuming they will be displayed verbatim.

questions.question: What information do Open Graph title and image metadata provide when sharing a page?
keyPoints: Platforms may apply their own preview rules
Metadata does not guarantee a particular display
questions.modelAnswer: og:title and og:image provide a suggested title and image for a shared-page preview. Platforms can apply their own rules, so the metadata does not guarantee an exact presentation.

questions.question: When can a canonical URL help, and what does it not do?
keyPoints: It identifies a preferred URL among similar pages
It can help consolidate duplicate or variant URLs
It is a hint interpreted by search engines
It does not redirect visitors by itself
questions.modelAnswer: A canonical link identifies the URL preferred for substantially similar content, which can help search engines understand duplicates or variants. It is a signal rather than a redirect, and crawlers may interpret it alongside other evidence.

questions.question: Why declare the document language, and what does a favicon do?
keyPoints: lang identifies the language of text
Language metadata helps pronunciation and language-aware tools
A favicon is a small site icon for browser interfaces
questions.modelAnswer: The lang attribute helps browsers and assistive technologies interpret the page's text with the right language rules and pronunciation. A favicon is a small icon that browsers may show in tabs and other interface locations.
